'''Julie''' (Japanese: '''ヨウコ''' ''Yōko'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG053|Game Winning Assist!]]''.

A former [[Pokémon Coordinator]], she now lives on a ranch near [[Fiery Path]], where she takes care of multiple {{p|Numel}}. However, she still makes [[Pokéblock]]s for her Pokémon using the {{Berries}} that grow on the ranch. After being chased out of Fiery Path by a group of {{p|Slugma}} and tumbling down a hill, {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} met Julie when they spotted one of her Numel. After introducing themselves, {{an|May}} decided to {{pkmn|battle}} Julie with her newly-{{pkmn2|caught}} {{TP|May|Skitty}} so it could gain [[experience]].

Overnight, {{TRT}} poached all of Julie's Numel. However, May and Skitty were also captured, and they helped them escape. Julie had Ash, {{an|Brock}}, and [[Max]] hop in the back of her truck as she pursued Team Rocket. She and her Furret then worked together with [[Ash's Pikachu]] to send the trio blasting off. The next day, Julie showed Ash and his friends the way to [[Mt. Chimney]].

|desc=Julie runs a {{p|Numel}} ranch, where the Numel enjoy grazing on the grassy plains and eating {{Berries}} from the surrounding trees. They are generally resting and have a tendency to wander off.

When Julie first met {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, she found a missing Numel of hers. She then revealed that she owns a ranch full of Numel. One of her Numel that was missing was slower than the other Numel. When the Numel were caught by {{TRT}}, the slow, dopey Numel tried to get over its speed problem with some support from {{an|May}} and her {{TP|May|Skitty}} to escape from Team Rocket's mecha. The dopey Numel attacking caused the other ones to join in and they were able to penetrate Team Rocket's mecha, thus finally escaping from it.

Numel's known moves are {{m|Tackle}} and {{m|Flamethrower}}.}}

Julie also used it in a battle against [[May's Skitty]]. Furret is very fast, dodging most of Skitty's attacks. During their battle, May learned about Skitty's {{m|Assist}} attack. Despite Skitty learning the new [[move]], Furret was able to defeat it.

Furret later defeated [[Jessie's Seviper]] with a powerful Slam attack before [[Ash's Pikachu]] sent {{TRT}} blasting off.

Furret's only known move is {{m|Slam}}.}}
